guide_reviews.conditional_boundary: Windows 10/11 WSL procedures are deferred non-goals with no actual-host validation claim.

outcomes.result: All 36 approved rows cover six User Guide scenarios in all six locales with locale-owned normalized PNGs, captions, alt text, and accepted visual QA.
boundaries: No screenshot coverage is claimed outside the approved minimal User Guide matrix.

outcomes.result: BPM and documentation use comfortable non-white light surfaces, aligned dark styling, and explicit light/dark/system behavior with maintained contrast and browser checks.
Search defaults to one line, expands without losing filter state, keeps deterministic offline ranking, and localizes every visible filter label.
boundaries: Hosted search, telemetry, LLMs, embeddings, vector databases, RAG, and generated answers are not supported.

outcomes.result: One locale-owned Documents/guide/section/topic hierarchy provides independent sidebar scrolling, direct-topic reveal, active focus, and reliable parent/root return without per-page tree copies.
The standalone API guide is absent from source publication, navigation, search, and manifests; all maintained API procedures are owned by the Administrator Guide.
boundaries: FastAPI OpenAPI remains available at /docs and is not the retired product-documentation guide.

outcomes.result: All six locales use runtime UI-catalog names, reviewed Pontoon/SUMO terminology, complete localized prose, and only occurrence-owned technical-English exceptions.
boundaries: Brands, stable abbreviations, identifiers, commands, paths, APIs, and placeholders remain language-neutral only where explicitly reviewed.

outcomes.result: All 120 supported policy rows and all 62 known managed-preference rows have exact manifest-backed localized documentation targets; unknown/raw and unavailable artifacts use explicit non-link dispositions.

Ubuntu 26.04, Debian 13.5, Fedora 44, Linux Mint 22.3, and Manjaro stable source procedures passed against retained clean userspace containers with migrations, six-locale documentation, runtime probes, and clean stop.
boundaries: OCI userspace evidence does not validate native boot, kernel, systemd, desktop, hardware, host firewall, host networking, or production operation.

outcomes.result: Neither actual Windows 10 nor Windows 11 host was supplied; both outcomes remain unverified-no-actual-host-supplied, claim no WSL validation, do not block the bounded documentation outcome, and allow a future actual-host rerun.
boundaries: Docker, Linux containers, ISO inspection, and static documentation checks do not validate WSL host integration.

outcomes.result: Screenshot, locale, schema, CIS, navigation, search, theme, help-link, deployment, update, integration, and live-evidence drift all have maintained fail-closed procedures.

remaining_non_goals: Screenshot coverage beyond the approved minimal User Guide matrix.
Validated Windows 10/11 WSL behavior without a successful maintained runner execution on each actual host.
Native-host Linux boot, kernel, systemd, desktop, hardware, firewall, and network validation.
Packaged installers, native Windows service support, official service units, production hardening, reverse-proxy/TLS recipes, HA, rolling upgrades, managed secrets, and automated restore guarantees.
AI-assisted runtime documentation search or question answering.

remaining_required_work: BPM091-M13-10 reviewed commit and M13-11 maintainer-run push handoff
